description.text: The WW domain is a protein module with two highly conserved tryptophans that binds proline-rich peptide motifs in vitro.

wikipedia.title: WW_domain
wikipedia.extract: The WW domain is a modular protein domain that mediates specific interactions with protein ligands. This domain is found in a number of unrelated signaling and structural proteins and may be repeated up to four times in some proteins. Apart from binding preferentially to proteins that are proline-rich, with particular proline-motifs, [AP]-P-P-[AP]-Y, some WW domains bind to phosphoserine- and phosphothreonine-containing motifs.
